cobblemon.ability.drama.desc: Its yawns are double: Yawn hits every adjacent foe and the sleep it causes lasts twice as long.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien.name: GatitoAlien
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien.desc: The official mascot of Emi's channel. Extremely loud and dramatic: it meows at everything, faints over nothing, and yawns so theatrically that the sleepiness spreads.
